evidence: This report explicitly recalls the Thursday-afternoon Tuin Khola/Three Kilo landslide that first blocked the Narayangadh-Muglin road.
These reports describe the renewed slide around 3:15 a.m. after the road had reopened Friday evening.
These reports explicitly describe another recurrence at about 11:35 a.m. on July 1 at the same road point.
The July 2 report describes a further landslide the previous night at Bridge No. 3 and notes repeated failures at the same location.
A landslide at Dana Titar, Annapurna-3 at about 7:15 a.m. blocked the Beni-Jomsom road.
A separate landslide at Daklang, Bhotekoshi-4 at about 10:30 a.m. obstructed the Araniko Highway.
